baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ joins an inwardly preferred outcome to the outward spread of الفاحشة within a community named by faith and security.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-held preference supplies motive, diffusion supplies social reach, conspicuous limit-crossing supplies the content, and the امن-rooted population supplies the trust environment being penetrated. The verse therefore reaches desire for a corrupted communal condition, not only a completed indecent act.

activation_trace.role: Heart-abiding love supplies the durable preference that powers the desired outcome.
Diffusion, dispersal, and multiplication supply the outward social movement of that preference's object.
Manifest ugliness supplies the socially recognizable content being made prevalent.
Security and trust make the affected believers a protected social interior rather than a neutral audience.

changed_reading.before: The verse punishes people who want immorality to become publicly known.
changed_reading.after: The verse targets attachment to a social end-state in which conspicuous violation saturates and destabilizes a trust-bearing community, even before the lover personally performs the violation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَشِيعَ can carry following, reinforcement, and a supporting group as well as impersonal diffusion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Spread can occur through people who accompany, repeat, and strengthen one another. On this branch, lovers of the outcome become relays or partisans of the violation, so prevalence is assembled through aligned succession rather than appearing spontaneously.

activation_trace.role: Love supplies the affiliative commitment that keeps participants attached to the relay.
Following and accompanying supply person-to-person succession in the transmission chain.
Mutual support and a following group supply reinforcement that gives the chain social force.
Exceeding a boundary supplies the norm-crossing object around which the relays align.

changed_reading.before: تشيع describes an item of scandal passively becoming widespread.
changed_reading.after: تشيع can implicate a human support structure: followers strengthen and escort the violation from person to person until it becomes prevalent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ and the contrast يَعْلَمُ ... لَا تَعْلَمُونَ frame a consequence whose full range exceeds present human appraisal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The near sphere and the later sphere place consequences on different horizons, while divine knowing versus human nonknowing marks an asymmetry in seeing the propagation chain. Painful punishment answers both visible injury and effects that remain delayed or unrecognized.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the proximate horizon on which social injury begins to register.
Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon on which unspent consequences remain.
Knowing versus not knowing supplies the unequal grasp of the chain's total effects.
Severe punitive pain supplies the answer to harm spanning both horizons.
Pain-causing force specifies that the consequence is experienced rather than merely declarative.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is assigned to this world and the afterlife, followed by a general assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The closing clauses make propagation a multi-horizon harm: humans see only its near segment, while divine knowledge encompasses deferred reach and grounds the painful accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence supplies an organized cluster, a principal carrier, speech poured outward, and a tongue-to-mouth pickup path. This turns the baseline partisan model into a concrete relay network with differentiated roles: cohesion and leadership initiate or magnify material that ordinary participants receive and retransmit.

activation_trace.role: A mutually reinforcing following supplies the focus anchor for coordinated rather than accidental spread.
A group that surrounds and supports one another supplies the compact social body behind the circulation.
Taking charge of an affair supplies an organizing role within the group.
The bulk of the affair supplies differentiated responsibility for the principal load.
Speech and report spreading like an outflow supply high-volume release into the social channel.
Receiving speech by taking and being taught it supplies the relay's intake operation.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the immediate handoff instrument.
The mouth as an outlet supplies the relay's retransmission port.

structural_cues: 24:11-15 moves from a bounded group and its chief burden-bearer to outflow, reception by tongues, and output through mouths.
The singular principal burden in 24:11 coexists with individual acquisition, allowing unequal responsibility inside one network.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group cohesion, management, bulk, outflow, reception, and speech organs; I infer a directed organizer-to-relay transmission chain. A live alternative is that these are adjacent descriptions of one incident without a general network model.

changed_reading.before: Spread is either ambient publicity or an undifferentiated collective act.
changed_reading.after: Spread is a role-structured process: a cohesive group and major carrier load the channel, while ordinary mouths complete the person-to-person relay and acquire their own share of responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly distinguishes hearing from knowledge and knowledge-backed witness from unsupported speech. Prevalence occurs when an auditory input is promoted into communal pseudo-knowledge without crossing the witness threshold; refusal to speak functions as an epistemic firewall protecting the امن-bearing community.

activation_trace.role: Trust and security supply the communal asset that unsupported transmission corrodes.
The focus contrast between knowing and not knowing anchors the model in epistemic status.
Testimony that states something from knowledge supplies the threshold that rumor fails to meet.
Bare auditory reception supplies an input that has not yet become warranted knowledge.
The explicit absence of knowledge marks the relay's evidentiary deficit.
A lie that stuns speaker or hearer supplies the kind of claim that should terminate rather than propagate.

structural_cues: 24:4 and 24:13 repeat a four-witness requirement, while 24:12 and 24:16 place the stopping response at the instant of hearing.
24:15 juxtaposes mouth-level assertion, absent knowledge, human minimization, and divine assessment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, absent knowledge, knowledge-bearing testimony, and a command-pattern of verbal refusal; I infer a gate that must stop unwarranted input before retransmission. A live alternative is a strictly forensic threshold with no broader communication-system force.

changed_reading.before: The offense is chiefly desiring broad exposure of indecency.
changed_reading.after: The offense includes defeating a communal knowledge protocol: converting what was merely heard into repeatable social fact without witness or knowledge, thereby making calumny prevalent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return to a like instance and repeated following of traceable steps convert one-time diffusion into recurrence. Each relay need not repeat an identical token; reproducing its likeness and following an established trace is enough to form a path that later participants can traverse.

activation_trace.role: Following and accompanying anchor spread in sequential human movement.
Returning after an initial occurrence supplies recurrence rather than a single lapse.
A likeness supplies replication that can vary in wording while preserving the harmful pattern.
Tracing an effect step after step supplies deliberate continuation along an existing route.
Footprints followed by a traveler supply the durable path produced by repeated small transmissions.

structural_cues: 24:17's prohibition on returning to its like precedes 24:21's twice-repeated follow-the-steps construction.
The movement is incremental: likeness permits recurrence without exact identity, and footsteps make cumulative direction from small units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, likeness, trace-following, and steps; I infer that retellings or reenactments create path dependence for later relays. A live alternative is that 24:21 gives a general moral sequence unrelated to information spread.

changed_reading.before: A scandal spreads through a burst of publicity.
changed_reading.after: A scandal becomes prevalent through recursive imitation: each small return to its likeness leaves a trace, and repeated following turns isolated participation into an established social route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same love-root is immediately redirected toward being forgiven, alongside pardon and graceful turning from the offense. Culpability therefore lies neither in strong desire nor in every form of social forgetting, but in selecting proliferation of disgrace rather than a restorative outcome that covers injury and refuses to keep it circulating.

activation_trace.role: Heart-abiding love anchors the faculty whose object is morally contrasted.
The repeated love asks the same faculty to attach itself to divine forgiveness instead.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense supply a restorative response to injury.
Gracefully turning aside from the wrong supplies refusal to perpetuate grievance.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from the trace supply the desired alternative social end-state.

structural_cues: 24:22 repeats the focus verb of love in a rhetorical question, but gives it forgiveness rather than prevalence of disgrace as its complement.
Pardon and turning the page precede the repeated love, making an actionable contrast rather than a bare lexical echo.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated love-root plus pardon, turning aside, and protective covering; I infer deliberate redirection of affect from scandal circulation to restoration. A live alternative is that the echo is exhortative without defining the focus verse's psychology.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns an unusually intense or illicit kind of desire.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts two objects for an ordinary but durable faculty: one can love the multiplication of disgrace, or love forgiveness enough to stop feeding the injury and restore the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later instructions build social membranes through entry, permission, visual reduction, guarding, and time-specific privacy. These cues turn فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا from a mere population label into a protected interior; making violation spread within it can operate by defeating consent and perception boundaries.

activation_trace.role: Security supplies the protected condition of the community named in the focus.
Diffusion supplies movement across and within the community's social interior.
Passage into an interior supplies the basic boundary-crossing operation.
Authorization supplies a consent gate that determines whether crossing may occur.
Lowering by deliberate reduction supplies a throttle on visual intake.
Guarding inviolability and chastity supplies preservation of the protected interior.
A concealed private exposure supplies the temporally gated material that must not become indiscriminately accessible.

structural_cues: 24:27-31 repeatedly regulates entry, permission, return, gaze, display, and concealment; 24:58-59 adds permission windows keyed to vulnerable times.
The focus preposition فِى permits a contained-community reading that these later inside/outside rules make operational.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry rules, authorization, reduced looking, guarding, and timed privacy; I infer a membrane system that modulates what can spread within the community. A live alternative is that these are independent household and modesty rules rather than a model for 24:19.

changed_reading.before: Among the believers merely identifies the audience among whom a report circulates.
changed_reading.after: Among the believers can name a secured social interior, so loving prevalence includes wanting protected material to cross consent, visual, and temporal boundaries until exposure becomes ambient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coercion scene in 24:33 supplies control over another person, her desire for protection, sexual exploitation, and a transient worldly return. It widens love of prevalence from enjoying or repeating scandal to maintaining incentives that manufacture the violation and force it into circulation.

activation_trace.role: Durable preference anchors the beneficiary's desired social outcome.
Boundary-exceeding ugliness anchors the kind of outcome being systemically produced.
The near worldly sphere anchors the immediate gain horizon contrasted with later consequence.
Protected sexual integrity supplies the agency and boundary the coerced person seeks to preserve.
Within the supplied occurrence set, sexual commerce supplies the violation being produced for others' use.
Forcing another into what she rejects supplies the controller's production mechanism.
Her will and intention supply the protected preference overridden by coercion.
A transient worldly good supplies the incentive that makes the controller reproduce the violation.

structural_cues: 24:33 grammatically opposes the women's desire for protection to another party's coercion for worldly goods.
The focus itself includes a worldly horizon, allowing immediate material benefit and deferred painful consequence to occupy the same causal account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercion, a contrary will toward protection, sexual commerce, and transient worldly gain; I infer that profit-seeking can create conditions in which violation spreads. A live alternative is a separate exploitation prohibition that should not broaden the focus beyond scandal circulation.

changed_reading.before: Those condemned approve of or retransmit indecency already present.
changed_reading.after: Those condemned may also be beneficiaries who want the conditions for indecency to proliferate and coercively produce it because its worldly circulation yields gain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fire-feeding branch of ش ي ع rather than its ordinary diffusion branch and contrasts it with the later lamp image. It remains anchored in تَشِيعَ and in branch-backed ignition, glass, and light cues from 24:35. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy distinguishing destructive attention from bounded illumination, not as the lexical sense required by the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ش ي ع inventory at تَشِيعَ includes strengthening a fire with fuel, making social attention available as a combustible model of spread.

activation_trace.role: Feeding and strengthening a fire supplies the exploratory image of attention as fuel for prevalence.
Deliberate ignition supplies a controlled comparison point for how fuel becomes active.
Transparent glass supplies a boundary that contains and transmits illumination without indiscriminate burning.
Illumination supplies the contrasting form of visibility that guides rather than consumes.

changed_reading.before: The verse opposes publicity, while later light imagery celebrates visibility, leaving a simple public-versus-private tension.
changed_reading.after: The material contrast suggests that visibility itself is not the target: culpable lovers feed an unbounded social fire, whereas beneficial disclosure is fueled, housed, and made illuminating.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation from the layered sea image and is therefore not a direct identification of rumor with 24:40. It remains valid as an exploratory model because تَشِيعَ anchors diffusion and لَا تَعْلَمُونَ anchors limited apprehension, while the packet supplies accumulating coverings and waves. Downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for emergent opacity, not an asserted referent of the sea image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَشِيعَ ... وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ permits a model in which repeated spread changes what participants can know about the whole process.

activation_trace.role: Dispersion and multiplication supply the accumulating social medium.
The knowing versus nonknowing contrast anchors unequal visibility of the whole process.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies one layer of information loss.
Interpenetrating disturbance supplies repeated relays that alter one another rather than merely add volume.
Parts stacked with other parts supply cumulative opacity produced by many local contributions.

changed_reading.before: You do not know means that humans lack facts known to God.
changed_reading.after: The analogy suggests a stronger systems claim: multiplying relays can generate layered opacity in which each participant handles a nearby fragment but loses sight of the originating act, total reach, and accumulated harm.

strongest_changes: The immediate context resolves prevalence into a coordinated receive-and-retransmit network with unequal but individual responsibility.
Witness and knowledge cues recast nonparticipation as an epistemic gate: hearing must not be promoted into social fact without warrant.
The repeated love-root in 24:22 redirects the same affective capacity from multiplying disgrace toward forgiveness and restoration.
Household boundaries and the coercion scene widen spread beyond speech to unauthorized exposure and incentive-driven production of violation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 24:19 read as governance of social transmission: affection supplies motive, groups and channels supply propagation, evidence and consent supply brakes, incentives can manufacture content, and divine knowledge measures hidden downstream reach.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the fire-lamp and layered-sea activations are intended whole-surah analogies or only useful branch-enabled heuristics.
Whether الفاحشة in this focus should remain tightly tied to calumny or retain the wider limit-crossing and coerced-production scope activated later.
How far الدنيا والآخرة should carry near and deferred causal horizons in addition to their conventional realm distinction.
